methodology.isolation: One fresh process per case/library; sequential jobs in seeded shuffled order; warmups excluded
methodology.timing: Includes construction, consumption, assertions per output, instrumentation, and cleanup; excludes prepared inputs, imports, post-run assertions, and process startup
methodology.io: Deterministic timer-based I/O simulation; every fifth item waits 4x latencyMs; no network or disk benchmark
methodology.bounds: maxAhead = pulled minus received by sink, including in-flight work; maxReady = mapper completions minus received; neither is a heap measurement
methodology.statistics: Median, min, max and every sample; no significance or cross-workload aggregate ranking
